tasks.short: Define transportation planning problems and priorities

steps.what: Review existing regional or local evidence on access, safety, congestion and travel demand
Clarify affected groups' needs and policy constraints with regional or local stakeholders
outputs: clarified planning needs and competing priorities

steps.what: Define the transportation problems and weigh regional or local planning priorities
inputs: clarified planning needs and competing priorities
outputs: defined planning problems and priority rationale

steps.what: Record and confirm the final problem definitions, priorities and unresolved evidence gaps
inputs: defined planning problems and priority rationale

steps.what: Save the approved problem statement in its current planning record

tasks.design: Configure linked {BI} indicators and {OTHER} GIS views for the existing regional evidence. The planner retains stakeholder clarification, problem definition and priority judgement, and records the final rationale in {PROJECT}.
tasks.previous_blocker: Existing evidence may be split across indicators and mapped areas.
tasks.enabler_now: Native area and period filters can reduce navigation while preserving source definitions.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve whose needs and which policy aims should receive priority.
tasks.human_edge: Define the problem rather than equate an indicator with a priority.

ambition.what: Make existing evidence easier to inspect when defining priorities.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: area-linked indicator and GIS views can organize existing transport evidence, while priority setting remains judgement.

assumptions: Boundary is defining problems and priorities, including their written rationale, not collecting new traffic surveys or modelling a proposed scheme.

Existing analysts and data owners supply indicator ID, definition, area, period, value, unit, source and limitations; consultation owners supply existing findings. s1 reads these and handles missing links manually. s4 counts actual statement and rationale capture; no free tagging producer is assumed.
Native evidence views come first. Central reduces only 20% of evidence navigation; interpretation, consultation and writing remain unchanged.
Same-record save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is retained. Final content precedes approval; edits void it. Provisional B=100, R=94, gross=6; focal upkeep=1; net=5, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Observe problem framing and separate evidence navigation from interpretation and stakeholder discussion.

already_counted.description: Inspect evidence and resolve area/period mismatches

incremental.description: Check indicator-area mappings and changed definitions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native views already organize the evidence. High: six gross points require two extra mapping-exception hours and one upkeep hour, leaving three.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in public transport planning meetings and hearings

steps.what: Prepare explanation aids from the current approved transport proposal
inputs: existing approved planning proposal and maps

steps.what: Participate in the public meeting or hearing, explain proposals and seek feedback or consensus
outputs: heard feedback and areas of agreement or disagreement

steps.what: Capture the actual feedback, questions and areas of agreement with attribution limits
inputs: heard feedback and areas of agreement or disagreement

steps.what: Organize, verify and approve the feedback record without overstating consensus
inputs: existing approved planning proposal and maps
outputs: approved public meeting feedback record v1

loop.purpose: Organize captured feedback into a faithful meeting record
loop.input: Planner's actual notes and proposal references
loop.output: Source-linked account retaining minority views and uncertainty
loop.check: Planner checks omissions, attribution, proposal linkage and whether any agreement claim exceeds the notes
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved summaries are written manually
loop.why_not_simpler: Free-text concerns and qualified agreements need narrative synthesis, not just sorting by a pre-existing code

steps.what: Save the approved feedback record in the current consultation workspace
inputs: approved public meeting feedback record v1
outputs: saved public meeting feedback record v1

tasks.design: Reuse approved proposal content and maps in native {DOCS} presentation templates. After the public meeting, a bounded draft organizes the planner's actual notes; the planner verifies minority views and consensus wording before saving the record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Preparation and post-meeting synthesis take time around the live hearing.
tasks.enabler_now: Templates and source-bound note synthesis can assist these separate artefacts.
tasks.still_hard: Listen, explain and seek agreement among people with conflicting interests.
tasks.human_edge: Understand concerns and represent disagreement honestly.

ambition.what: Reduce preparation and synthesis while preserving public participation.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: templates can reuse approved proposal material and bounded drafting can organize actual feedback with human verification.

assumptions: Boundary includes participation, explanation aids, actual feedback capture and the internal feedback record. External publication or follow-up sends are separate actions, not hidden in meeting time.

Existing proposal owners supply approved version, maps and explanatory content; s1 checks reuse. s3 counts capture of actual concern, question, relevant proposal element, speaker attribution where permitted, and qualification. No recording or automatic participant transcription is assumed.
Native templates come first. Central reduces half of preparation and 40% of post-meeting organization; all attendance, listening and raw note capture remain unchanged.
Same-workspace save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is retained. Final feedback synthesis exists and is checked before approval; edits void it.
Provisional B=100, R=88.9, gross=11.1; focal upkeep=1.1; net=10. Shares are independent of means priors.
research_questions: Compare organized records with original notes and time corrections of attribution and agreement claims.

incremental.description: Audit feedback fidelity and maintain proposal templates

approvals.approved_version: approved public meeting feedback record v1

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: existing templates and records already cover the proposed work. High: 11.1 gross points face three extra feedback-correction hours and 1.1 upkeep hours, leaving seven.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Prepare transportation planning reports and recommendations

steps.what: Gather the applicable transport analyses, maps, consultation findings and policy constraints
inputs: existing consultation findings and policy requirements

steps.what: Choose the transportation planning findings and recommendations and record their rationale
Draft the transportation report or recommendation with source-linked narrative and figures

loop.purpose: Compose the planner's chosen findings and recommendation rationale
loop.input: Verified analysis tables, maps, consultation findings and planner rationale
loop.output: Source-linked report draft with fixed numeric exhibits
loop.check: Planner verifies causal and policy claims, uncertainty, consultation representation and whether recommendations follow the recorded rationale
loop.stop: One draft and one correction; unresolved sections return to manual writing
loop.why_not_simpler: Recommendations need a coherent explanation across heterogeneous evidence; deterministic templates handle exhibits and references first

steps.what: Validate the report's figures, reasoning and recommendation fidelity and approve the final version
Save the approved report in its current report workspace

tasks.design: Link checked analyses from {PROJECT} and {OTHER}, the transport modelling/GIS repository, into a {DOCS} report template. A bounded model drafts only the planner's chosen narrative; the planner validates meaning and evidence before saving the final report.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence assembly and recommendation prose require repeated manual work.
tasks.enabler_now: Source-linked templates and bounded composition can assist report preparation.
tasks.still_hard: Choose defensible recommendations under uncertainty and competing policy goals.
tasks.human_edge: Accept the reasoning and public implications of the report.

ambition.what: Prepare traceable recommendation updates when evidence changes.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: source-bound drafting can compose reports around fixed analyses, with human verification of reasoning and claims.

assumptions: Boundary is report/recommendation preparation, not running new studies or publishing the report.

Existing analysts supply analysis ID/version, scenario, table values/units, method and limits; consultation owners supply actual findings. s1 verifies these and handles missing references manually. s2 counts capture of selected findings, recommendation, rationale, uncertainty and policy basis. No model creates new findings or references.
Native report templates and source links come first. Central retains 60% of gathering and 40% of composition, with full recommendation choice and final review unchanged.
Same-document save is effectively zero; minimum 1 earns no saving. Approval follows completed revisions and edits void it.
Provisional B=100, R=73, gross=27; focal upkeep=1; net=26, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Compare accepted recommendations and citations with the source pack and time every correction.

already_counted.description: Verify report figures, meaning and recommendation rationale

incremental.description: Maintain report mappings and audit source fidelity

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: native reporting already covers the proposed work. High: 27 gross points require six extra evidence/correction hours and one upkeep hour, leaving 20.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Resolve complex transport design issues with engineers

steps.what: Review the current design issue, transport model results and engineering interfaces
inputs: existing transport and engineering model revisions

steps.what: Collaborate with engineers to research constraints and alternative explanations for the design issue
outputs: agreed analysis questions and alternative designs

steps.what: Compare transport effects and engineering interface constraints for the alternative designs
inputs: agreed analysis questions and alternative designs
existing versioned scenario results and engineering constraint values
outputs: checked alternative-design comparisons and unresolved issues

steps.what: Agree a design resolution or further research need with engineers
inputs: checked alternative-design comparisons and unresolved issues
outputs: agreed design resolution and remaining uncertainty

steps.what: Record and approve the agreed issue resolution, evidence and follow-up owners
inputs: agreed design resolution and remaining uncertainty
checked alternative-design comparisons and unresolved issues
outputs: approved transport design issue record v1

steps.what: Save the approved issue record in its current project record
inputs: approved transport design issue record v1
outputs: saved transport design issue record v1

tasks.design: Link {PROJECT} issues to exact {OTHER} transport/engineering revisions and configure deterministic comparison tables for supported scenarios. The planner and engineers retain research, interpretation and agreement on the resolution, which the planner records separately.
tasks.previous_blocker: Revision navigation and comparison tables can require repeated manual matching.
tasks.enabler_now: Native revision links and explicit scenario/constraint keys can assist supported comparisons.
tasks.still_hard: Resolve interactions that are not captured by available model outputs.
tasks.human_edge: Combine planning and engineering judgement around the unresolved issue.

ambition.what: Reduce supported evidence handling within collaborative analysis.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: versioned scenario and constraint tables can support deterministic comparisons, while complex design resolution needs expert interpretation.

assumptions: Boundary includes the planner's collaboration, comparison and issue record, not the engineers' design work. Other participants' unchanged labour is not claimed as focal saving.

Existing model owners supply scenario/revision ID, output measure, area/link, period, value/unit and method limits; engineers supply the applicable constraint value, unit and design revision in normal issue work. Missing or incomparable fields stay manual in s3. New runs or measurements require a revised estimate, not a free input.

s5 counts actual resolution, rationale, uncertainty and owner capture. Native links/comparison views come first. Central removes 20% of context navigation and 20% of repeated table matching only; research, interpretation and agreement remain.
Same-project save is effectively zero; minimum 1 is retained. Approval follows the final issue record and edits void it.
Provisional B=100, R=91, gross=9; focal upkeep=1; net=8, independent of means priors.
research_questions: Trace resolved issues to exact model revisions and measure manual comparison versus interpretation.

already_counted.description: Check comparisons and resolve unsupported interfaces

incremental.description: Maintain scenario/constraint mappings and revision links

approvals.approved_version: approved transport design issue record v1

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: existing model views already cover the handling. High: nine gross points face three extra revision/comparison exception hours and one upkeep hour, leaving five.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Transportation planners retain problem framing, public engagement and recommendation judgement while traceable evidence views and bounded writing assist preparation.
reach: Engineers: agree comparable scenario and constraint definitions
Consultation team: preserve actual public feedback
skills_to_grow: Trace design comparisons to exact revisions
role.ambitious_version: A transportation planner who can explain defensible recommendations from traceable evidence while retaining public dialogue and engineering collaboration.
